question:
Write the weekly leadership briefing for the week starting 2025-06-23.
The KPI table was already looked up for you (do not re-query it):
- Revenue: $12,388, vs last week +6.2%, vs 4-week average -82.6%
- Margin: $6,879, vs last week +6.5%, vs 4-week average -77.7%
- Margin %: 55.5%, vs last week +0.1 pts, vs 4-week average +3.0 pts
- Units sold: 504, vs last week -2.3%, vs 4-week average -16.4%
- Orders: 211, vs last week -5.4%, vs 4-week average -19.3%

Investigate with your tools:
1. detect_anomalies for revenue and margin_pct with period "2025-Q2": grain "week" with by "total",
   and grain "month" with by "channel" and by "territory" (reseller orders arrive about once a
   month, so weekly checks by channel or territory raise false alarms).
2. run_sql to find out WHY the biggest change happened (channel, territory, category, discount).
3. make_chart once or twice (e.g. weekly revenue by channel for the last 13 weeks as a bar chart;
   Reseller orders arrive about monthly, so a line would mislead).

Only give a reason if a tool result shows it; otherwise say it needs checking. No forecasts.
Reply in EXACTLY this format (every number from a tool result or the table):
HEADLINE: <one sentence>
WHAT CHANGED AND WHY:
- <2-3 bullets>
WATCH LIST:
- <1-3 bullets, one per unusual run found, with dates and numbers>
FOLLOW-UPS:
- <2-3 recommended actions or questions for the team>
answer:
HEADLINE: The week starting 2025-06-23 rebounded modestly, but the quarter still shows a major disruption from missing Reseller activity and a sharp swing in margin %.

WHAT CHANGED AND WHY:
- Revenue was $12,388, up 6.2% vs last week, while margin was $6,879, up 6.5%; margin % was 55.5%, up 0.1 pts, so the week improved slightly but stayed far below the 4-week average on revenue and margin.
- The biggest change in Q2 was the collapse in Reseller activity: detect_anomalies flagged Reseller revenue as low in 2025-05 to 2025-06, with no sales at all in 2025-05 and 2025-06; the weekly chart shows the period is effectively all Online.
- The margin % spike in Q2 was concentrated in late June: detect_anomalies flagged total margin % high from 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-23, and the weekly chart shows the latest weeks were the strongest in the period.

WATCH LIST:
- Revenue anomaly: total revenue was unusually low from 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-16, with a peak of $11,031 vs about $442,018 expected.
- Margin % anomaly: total margin % was unusually high from 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-23, with a peak of 56.9% vs about 41.5% expected.
- Channel/territory anomaly: Reseller had no sales at all in 2025-05 and 2025-06; territory checks also flagged no sales in Central and Northeast in 2025-06.

FOLLOW-UPS:
- Check whether the missing Reseller orders are a data timing issue or a real operational gap, since the monthly channel pattern makes weekly noise misleading.
- Review the late-June Online mix and discounting to confirm whether the higher margin % is sustainable or just a temporary product/channel mix shift.
- Investigate the territories flagged as missing in June, especially Central and Northeast, to confirm whether shipments were delayed or not booked yet.

Checked with: q1, q2, q3
